notes.title: Researchers Diary Day 4
notes.notes:
[p]The first chest dummy is finished!
As this is mega early game I don't think there will be more chests needed.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033345/ddc1305c20e6a1b2f231ffb33dd5a959b8fb0d46.gif"][/img]

You can carry two chests with you, one in each hand, technically that alone gives you an extra 16 slots of inventory space. 8 slots per chest.

I am still trying to find posture appreciating mechanics and I like the auto opening when dropped.

That way you don't need to crouch to interact with chests and it's convenient for seated players.

The chest handles themselves can be grabbed, but also distance grabbed, therefore you don't need to get into the vicinity of the handle if you don't care/can't.

Currently it is within base building, you can place it with all the snapping that comes with it.

But unlike other machines, you can pick it up and carry with you, if you like.[/p]

notes.title: Researchers Diary Day 3
notes.notes:
[p]The very first machine is done! Or at least the dummy.

Why this is an important step:

 Inputs and Outputs for machines are defined
 Recipes, while hardcoded for now, work as intented
 It only works when powered on, which is a whole can of worms to get working
 It has a monitor displaying stuff
 It saves and loads as expected
With all machines following the same principle input -> do something when powered -> output, this basically covers all machines.

Plus, I could reuse the same code for saving and loading storage items.
Shelves, cabinets, done. Great!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45033345/6c7592062632f3f8e8d284aa02199411d9f2a445.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Researchers Diary Day 1
notes.notes:
Welcome to the first big news for Playable Alpha.
Firstly I want to apologize for everyone who is still in it for a looter shooter.
It is now a survival game on a newly discovered planet.
Making a shooter in VR turned out to be in insane amount of work, so I pulled the plug before it pulls mine.

The game is slowly reaching a playble state and the demo is in full swing on its way.
Here is a current state of affairs video.

[previewyoutube=fWRjZvuCHDs;full][/previewyoutube]

Keep in mind it will be a version 0.00001 so don't expect too much .. BUT here is a rundown of what is already implemented:

1. Survival mechanics: Health, oxygen, water, food
2. Base Building basics: Everything planet surface related, e.g. solar panels, wind turbines, fabricator
3. Powergrid mechanic. Yes there are powergrids.
4. Jetpack mechanic
5. Saving and loading, though for the first demo release it might be a one slot only save
6. VR Player with hands, there is no full person rig yet, also not planned, yet
7. Playble while seated or standing, I suppose room scale works too, but I can't test that

Visually everything consists of placeholders for now.
Don't expect an AAA title, please.

I am looking forward to bringing you more news soon.
Demo date is estimated to be within 1-2 months tops.
It will also remain the "full version" of the game until way later in time.
You could call it early access if you will, but as the game is miles away from an early access, so I decided to go with the demo tag instead :)
